# Membership Levels

## Problem

Some activities or clubs may require different levels of commitment or membership fees, but there's currently no way to differentiate between membership types.

## Recommended Solution

Implement a membership level system with:

- Different membership tiers (e.g., Basic, Premium, VIP)
- Associated fees for each tier
- Benefits description for each level
- Link membership levels to specific activities or clubs
- Display membership requirements when students view activities

## Context

This feature will help the school manage activities that require membership fees or have different participation levels. The system should clearly show what benefits each tier provides and what activities are available at each level.
